AgentMessageDelivery.description:
Codex v2 assistant message delivery mode.

The current upstream contract only exposes `async`; keeping this as a
closed enum prevents arbitrary presentation strings from crossing the
protocol boundary.

end.description: Exclusive byte offset in the UTF-8 text buffer.

start.description: Inclusive byte offset in the UTF-8 text buffer.

CodexErrorInfo.description: Codex-compatible error classification exposed on the v2 wire.

CollaborationMode.description: Collaboration mode for a session or turn.

CollaborationModeSettings.description: Collaboration mode settings copied from the Codex protocol shape.

details.description: Optional extra guidance or error details.

path.description: Optional path to the config file that triggered the warning.

range.description: Optional range for the error location inside the config file.

ErrorNotification.description: Reports a transient retry or terminal error for the current turn.

willRetry.description: True only when App Server has already decided to retry this turn.

GuardianWarningNotification.description: Reports a high-priority Guardian circuit-breaker warning for a thread.

ModeKind.description: Initial collaboration mode for a turn or session.

PlanDeltaNotification.description:
EXPERIMENTAL - proposed plan streaming deltas for plan items. Clients should
not assume concatenated deltas match the completed plan item content.

ReasoningEffort.description:
Typed reasoning effort carried by collaboration tool calls.

Codex accepts model-defined values in addition to its well-known levels.
A transparent validated wrapper preserves those values without falling
back to an untyped `String` field in the public Item contract.

ScheduledTaskChangedNotification.description: Invalidates Scheduled Tasks list/detail projections after a task mutation.

ScheduledTaskRunUpdatedNotification.description: Projects a terminal Scheduled Task run for GUI refresh and OS notification.

ServerRequestResolvedNotification.description: Emitted after a server-initiated request reaches a terminal state.

SessionSource.description: Origin of a thread session, aligned with Codex v2's typed source contract.

SkillsChangedNotification.description: Signals that the process-wide Skill catalog must be read again.

StrictReviewRequiredNotification.description:
Signals that a Guardian-backed tool review requires the strict-review
surface before execution continues.

startedAtMs.description: Unix timestamp (in milliseconds) when this review started.

canAcceptDirectInput.description:
Whether this thread may accept direct input from an App Server client.
Spawned child threads are parent-owned and must be driven through the
canonical agent-control route instead.

projectId.description: Canonical project assignment owned by App Server, if any.

ThreadItemMetadata.description:
Safe, display-only provenance carried by imported historical items.

The canonical store keeps richer metadata, but only these stable markers
cross the v2 boundary. In particular, raw source payloads and capabilities
are intentionally excluded.

TurnDiffUpdatedNotification.description: Reports the latest aggregated unified diff for the current turn.

TurnPlanUpdatedNotification.description: Reports the latest turn-scoped execution checklist.

TurnStartedNotification.description:
Notification payloads are kept beside the request contract so the v2
projection can use the same Thread/Turn identity without a second DTO.

UserInput.description: User input parts accepted by the v2 turn contract.

WarningNotification.description: A user-visible runtime warning projected from the current event stream.

code.description: Lime-owned warning code used for localized presentation.

message.description: Concise warning message for the user.

threadId.description: Optional thread target when the warning applies to a specific thread.

description:
Notifications emitted by the current v2 skeleton. Unknown methods fail
closed until their typed payloads are added to the v2 catalog.
title: ServerNotification
